signals.summary: Fiserv cut 98 New Jersey jobs in September 2026, bringing 2026 New Jersey cuts above 200 amid restructuring toward automation.
WARN filing for 118 roles at Berkeley Heights, New Jersey, with separations dated March 31 to May 31, 2026.
Severance costs hit $113 million in the first half of 2026 versus $29 million a year earlier, plus $329 million of transformation expense.
One Fiserv plan reengineers the operating model using AI and advanced automation; two offices closed and India merchant business ended.
Takis Georgakopoulos became CEO in June 2026, the second chief executive change in thirteen months.
Fiserv remains highly profitable but revenue growth has slowed from pandemic-era double-digit expansion, pressuring margins.
